threads.rawContent:
What’s with all the hype about the 2021 era of TDS? I have seen too many people claim that this era of the game was one of the best, completely ignoring the massive issues and only supporting their points with ‘nostalgia and that the game is really just corporate slop right now’. If you were actually around earlier, you would know that back in like 2022-2023, 2021 was seen as the worst year for the game or close it, and once you look more into it, it’s not exactly hard to understand why. 

THE ISSUES
The Balancing of the Game’s Towers
If you were around for most of the Overhaul - Solar Eclipse era, you probably remember that the balancing of the game was atrociously bad, this trend started in the Overhaul update. Half of the towers were made useless, with extremely expensive costs just to contribute nothing. 

One clear example of this was Mortar and Rocketeer in Pre-Overhaul, two towers you were really required to use to get past the shielded enemies with a damage cap. When the Overhaul update dropped, the shield damage cap mechanic was completely removed, that change itself isn’t necessarily bad, but both tower’s stats were nerfed to barely being usable. 

The Overhaul Update did start this, but Frost Invasion did not make it any better. You have the Militant rework which the devs said would make the tower better… by adding a very limiting ammo system. Solar Eclipse brought along the Hunter rework which changed pretty much nothing. 

Obviously, every tower defense game is going to have its meta, which is completely normal. My main point here is that 2021 TDS has so many useless shop obtainable towers. Comparing it to the current era of the game, the game’s beginner to intermediate towers aren’t completely useless, they actually serve their purpose. Back in the 2021 era though? If you bought Militant, Rocketeer, and Paintballer, congratulations, you find out that all your grinding was for nothing.

The Abundance of Bugs
The next major issue is that this era was RIDDLED with bugs.  You have many bugs that were completely ignored by the devs until the next update that would come within months. A few examples are Pursuit and Ace Pilot not being immune to stuns, Medic’s stun cleanse ability doing nothing at all, and many visual bugs regarding cosmetics of the towers. The tower bugs stayed, hindering the tower for months, while the visual bugs were just annoying but seeing them stay for over a year from Overhaul to Solar Eclipse was really dumb since these were so easy to fix. 

And then there are towers getting released into the game while still having their own major bugs. Toxic Gunner is one clear example. Back in its release, this tower was able to slow down every enemy in the game by 50%, PERMANENTLY. Equipping this tower basically made the game a free win (for the most part). This was fixed 2 months later, but the aforementioned Pursuit/Ace Pilot and Medic bugs stayed until Solar Eclipse 5 months later.

Once Toxic Gunner was fixed, players resorted to other ways to break the game. The Military Base bug. This was actually in the game for quite a while now but didn’t receive widespread attention until Toxic Gunner was patched. This was then fixed 2-3 weeks later. 

And because of how bad the game’s balancing was, players had to use these game breaking bugs just to beat Hidden Wave/Hardcore. The Overhaul Era didn’t really have this issue, you could still beat those two perfectly fine with legitimate strategies, but when Frost Invasion came, Hardcore was made harder because the intended price inflation mechanic was fixed for placement costs. When you were struggling to beat Hardcore, all you had to do for most of the game was just abuse these game-breaking bugs. 

Right after the Military Base bug was fixed, there was another bug players discovered to abuse. Holding the Minimize/Maximize button of your Roblox tab, this made the game freeze and not let you join into a game until you let go of the button, and by doing this, if there was already one player in the game, then you joined right after the round starts, the rest of the game would give you the wave bonus as if it were a solo game. This was then fixed 2 months later in September.

I get that the devs had to be quick on fixing bugs that give you free wins, but there’s no reason for them to NOT have fixed the aforementioned other tower and visual bugs.

If players are abusing bugs that were never intended to exist, solely because these are the best ways to beat hard gamemodes, that is more than “harmless.” It’s bad game design.

The Elevators
A more minor issue people have overlooked is that matchmaking/parties did not exist at all in this era. (it was actually added on Solar Eclipse, but that was only for the event itself) Do you remember how annoying it was when you had to spend so much time actually getting on a solo game because there were so many randoms infesting your elevator? You could solve this by using a Private Server.. Which costs robux. Not all players have that.
Do you know how convenient the party system is right now? It still has its limitations on public servers, only letting you veto once, that is still much better than the elevator hell that infested most of the game up to 2023. No wonder people don’t miss elevators being the main way to join/start games.

Nostalgia
This is probably the biggest reason why this era of the game has been so glorified.  Many players who are new to a game often find the era they first started playing in, their favorite era. That’s completely understandable. 
Let me tell you one thing. The memories were good, that doesn’t mean the game itself was actually good. I first started playing TDS way back in 2019, I have a lot of happy memories and nostalgia, getting home from school, then immediately hopping on the game, not a single worry in the world, but that doesn’t mean the game was flawless. The same applies to 2021.

Even with all of my  points bashing on the 2021 TDS era, I still have a lot of memories of just hopping on Roblox for hours after online class. I was grinding the Frost Invasion battlepass, beating Hidden Wave many times with a trusted group of friends, Summer 2021 for me was just a really enjoyable time. Underneath all of that happiness though, at the time, I still found it hard to ignore the massive issues the game had in this era. Many people in the community were complaining about easy-to-fix bugs staying for months, along with many of the towers just being bad.  I don’t let all my nostalgia of 2021 TDS completely blind me to all the problems it had.

Current Era of the game
Before anyone interprets this post as me defending everything about the modern era of the game, I can also say it also has absolutely legitimate criticisms, stemming from the game’s excessive power creep, abundance of progression, too much monetization, etc. I agree. I don’t play the game much anymore these days because all they’re adding is just more and more content that feels really tedious to grind for, but when you look back at earlier eras that had massive issues as well…

I’m not arguing 2021 TDS was absolutely horrible, you can enjoy the older events, gameplay, community, that’s completely valid. Solar Eclipse is still my favorite event to this day.  The main reason why I made this post is because I’ve seen some people outright say the 2021 TDS was peak, and completely dismiss all of its issues, while also saying “modern era bad” without any constructive arguments. 

Each era has its own issues. 2021 TDS can have memories and a simpler time but has many issues regarding bugs and balancing, while the modern era can have more quality-of-life features, but has too many monetization and power creep issues. Neither era is “peak golden age”.  It is more reasonable to acknowledge both era’s strengths and weaknesses.

So that finally concludes this long post. I hope you took your time to read all of this and understand my points. You are open to debate and criticize some of my points constructively.

threads.rawContent:
The 2008 housing and economic crisis was a time period where the housing market bubble popped and caused a recession. Tds is a roblox game. Now on paper these 2 do not have anything in common. However, there are plenty of similarities.

Lets start at the beginning: in the 90s the US goverment passed and changed some laws making low income houses more affordable with lower interest rates and such. This allowed for people to make more riskier investments.

In 2021 there were only about 8 or so vaible towers in tds. You had accel and gmini for dps. Your buffs and gold scout or glad for early game.
In the coming years the game would slowly start reworking starter towers. First scout, hunter, sniper, soldier, militant and finnaly Shotgunner in the early months of 2022. These changes brought new life into older towers and made them relevant. Also in 2022, new towers were added like the warden and elf camp. Towers which wernt 100% original but put a unique spin on the concept. In 2023 this became more rampant as more towers were getting rebalances and reworks , including some major ones like accelerator, ranger and minigunner.

Getting back to the crisis. Banks were handing out MBS. Which were basically mortgages that had very low interest rates for a few years before they increased drastically. And banks traded around these debts. They would sell all these dabts to someone so the banks can give out money faster and the person they sold it to would eventually get money from people paying off the mortgages. However, after awhile they ran out of people to sell to and had to start selling to sketchy individuals, people who were less likely to pay off the debts.


In 2024 brawler released. He completely outshined warden in every aspect. Later that year pursuit got reworked. Having full map coverage. Every detection and 2 paths because why not. 2025 wasnt any better. Biologist was added. Being able to solo the early waves of pw2. Assassin was added, another melee tower, the 6th one. And warlock, having bleed. Knockback, aoe and extremely high dps. Knocking every other dps tower out of the park. 


So how does this connect? Well the mortgages are towers. 2024 pumped out about 9 towers. Thats as much as the previous 3 years combined. Not to mention the reworks too. When you start mass producing towers eventually you are going to run out of ideas and the powercreep is going to set in. Its 2026 and warlock (who hasent even been out a year) is already forgotten. And she never received to harsh of a nerf. Its just there too many other towers.

So what is the solution. The 2008 economic crisis was solved by the government stimulating the economy and bailing out financial institutions. I dont know how it translates to tds. Maybe it is time for some new dirastic idea.

threads.rawContent:
All Screenshots date to Version "Smaller = Bigger" in 2020.

Outlaw (Now Ranger) Stacking in Old Badlands.
Molten Difficulty
I remember I was helping some folks get Cowboy. 
Getting into a lobby with the Highest levelled Player at the time, we had practically the same loadout except for one tower (He Had DJ iirc while I had Pyro (I asked him what his loadout was)).
This was when Level affected HP, so our base health was a whopping 1,331 HP.
Yes, back then the highest level was 867, and that was already absurd as my at-the-time Level of 154 was in itself considered high.
Triumph on the heights. Just a standard fallen game on a map i really struggled with for some reason.
Yes back then we were paid pocket change for these 32-40 minute games.
You can also see the Old Enforcer (before he was changed to shotgunner) and the Twitter Minigunner on the background.
Level 5 Golden Crook Boss with his beard shaven. You can see what he'd look like bearded in the background. Additionally, theres also the old Golden Crook unit which looked surprisingly boring. 
Funilly enough on his old models, one of the Tommy guns would have a drum mag while the other wouldn't. Interesting design choice for old Golden CB.

threads.rawContent:
Hunter used to be unique since back then tds towers werent as mechanically complex, now simply being a ground sniper does not cut it for an intermediate tower, considering other towers in its same tier such as crook boss, medic, freezer, military base, trapper, or even less complex towers such as rocketeer, shotgunner, and pyromancer being more mechanically distinct then "I fire slow to deal high damage!". Not to mention the design is getting quite outdated, given the fact its first rework was back in late 2021. Given the fact the tower had a very clear identity before the rework, this rework aims to hone into that. This rework wont focus on anything visual (because i do not have the artistic talent for that and I wont resort to shoving my ideas into AI)

Base Stats
Coin Cost: 2000
Placement Limit: 8
Firerate: 2 Seconds
Damage: 20
Range: 25
Placement Cost: 1500
Detections: Hidden
Placement Footprint: Normal (i don't know EXACT sizes ok lets just say its same as scout or militant)
Passives
Eagles Eye: Deals 1.25x damage to hidden enemies.

Level 1
Price: 500
Upgrade Name: Hunting Gear
Damage: 20 --> 24
Firerate: 2 --> 1.8 Seconds

Level 2
Price: 1500
Upgrade Name: Keen Vision
Flying Detection Added
Range: 25 --> 27.5
Damage: 24 --> 30
Eagles Eye: 1.25x --> 1.35x More Damage to Hidden Enemies

Level 3
Price: 6500
Upgrade Name: Apex Hunter
Eagles Eye: 1.35x --> 1.4x More Damage to hidden Enemies
Hunter now deals 1.2x more damage to flying enemies.
Both dont stack, if an enemy has both flying and hidden, the damage multiplier against flying enemies takes priority over the damage multiplier, im not trying to make hunter the next 2025 rocketeer.
Range: 27.5 --> 32.
Damage: 30 --> 85
Firerate: 1.8 --> 1.6 Seconds

Level 4
Price: 15000
Upgrade Name: Huntsman's Companion
Eagles Eye: 1.4x --> 1.5x More Damage to Hidden Enemies
1.2x --> 1.4x damage to flying enemies.
Range: 32 --> 35
Damage: 85 --> 200
Firerate: 1.6 Seconds --> 2.5 Seconds
New Passive: Falcons Eye
A falcon now circles around hunter visually
Every tower within 7 range of hunter is granted flying detection.

And thats it, please give feedback im open to it, goal was to make hunter more mechanically complex to be on par with modern roster, while making it a good option for intermediate players, while still usable for players throughout any stage of the game.

I don't know what you're expecting if this is sudden to you
All runs are with saboteur cause I decided I'm not gonna learn solo pw2 with engineer

W1 is TOTAL BULLSHIT. 1/3 chance to even pass it with saboteur and maybe a 1/1.5 chance to pass W2. There's also the lowish chance to get the correct amount of starting money (can be 950 instead of 1187) although I haven't struggled with that RNG all that much. Documenting new strats for other towers for solo pw2 (like using snowballer or engineer rather than saboteur) is NOT fun either, takes like an hour that feels like 2. W25 abomination and necro king are genuinely so infuriating too because sometimes abomination dies at roughly the end of the third loop which means it's out of hacker's range and becomes reanimated rather than bugged and just a hologram. Necro king can get really far and also distract units cause I have to neuralyze it and kill it before somebody gets hurt (same with its summons depending on how far necro king is). Not to mention on top of all of this the devs could shadow update and fix hacker bugs (makes solo pw2 entirely impossible) or nerf saboteur JUST ENOUGH to make this impossible. I haven't mentioned splitters yet either, they make runs a lot closer or entirely end them because of circuits (LOOKING AT YOU, W16). For more specific context on why W1 is RNG as well, the shotgun bullets from saboteur can miss wasterunners and fuck up everything because a lot of stuff needs to be done PERFECTLY BRO

Trio hardcore matchmaking is genuinely more fun than this, seriously

threads.rawContent: Evolved towers are pretty obviously the biggest powercreep since accel's release for like a good 85% of the game's roster (really only being comparable to hardcore towers), events could easily be beaten due to their meta state rn, now they could just make hard mode, harder, but that would just make the tower requirements for both modes of events way bigger, tdx actually has a pretty simple fix to that, since it released its 4 nightmare towers (5th one in march) in mid october of 2025, being equivalent to tds' hardcore towers but having powercreep of evolved towers or on release accelerator. Any event released since those towers' release (except HLWN 25 due to its rushed nature) have had 3 modes to account for the insane powercreep said towers have. TDS could fix alot of powercreeping issues that non-end game players have, locking the event tower to hard mode but having like achievements and better battlepass currency rates on this hypotethical third mode
